name: Harness Engineering
outcome: Configure a reproducible coding-agent harness with independently enforced execution boundaries and verification gates.
description: Engineer the environment around a coding agent: repository policies, controlled execution, deterministic feedback and recoverable state. Extend an existing CLI rather than build a new agent framework.
learn: Configure a bounded agent execution environment
Enforce deterministic checks independently of the agent
Resume a failed task from recorded state without losing audit evidence
tools: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (choose one)
prior: Competencies from S04, including agent operation and verification
Python, Git and shell scripting; basic container concepts
practice: Extend the Lotka–Volterra repository with a small wrapper that runs the selected CLI in a disposable workspace and verifies changes.
acceptance: A deliberately failing check blocks acceptance; execution respects the workspace boundary; a resumed run retains task state and evidence.
external: Python, Git and shell scripting; basic container concepts
moduleDescriptions: Separate the model, tools, context, execution environment and state.
Configure a test and lint command that blocks invalid changes.
Record task state and recover after a controlled interruption.
Compare a baseline and guarded run using independent acceptance checks.
prerequisiteRationale: S04 establishes the verification targets and failure checks that this course turns into enforceable runtime controls.
